entities.name: KATNAL1
observations: The 523-aa query matches reviewed KATNAL1 references at 57% identity and 98.9% query coverage (E-values 1.63e-188 to 2.31e-188); Pfam detects KATNA1_MIT and AAA-family domains.

Reviewed homolog annotations describe ATP-dependent microtubule severing; the human reference reports cytoplasm/cytoskeleton, mitotic spindle, spindle poles, and centrosome localization, and cytoplasmic microtubule organization.
